scripts.predev: npm run build -w @ai-re-agent/contracts && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web,search --prefix-colors cyan,green,yellow "npm run dev -w @ai-re-agent/server" "npm run dev -w @ai-re-agent/web" "npm run search:watch -w @ai-re-agent/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ai-re-agent/contracts && npm run build -w @ai-re-agent/server && npm run build -w @ai-re-agent/web
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web,search "npm run start -w @ai-re-agent/server" "npm run preview -w @ai-re-agent/web" "npm run search:start -w @ai-re-agent/server"
scripts.search:once: npm run build -w @ai-re-agent/contracts && npm run search:once -w @ai-re-agent/server
scripts.enrich: npm run build -w @ai-re-agent/contracts && node --import tsx server/src/enrich.ts
scripts.search:watch: npm run build -w @ai-re-agent/contracts && npm run search:watch -w @ai-re-agent/server
